title: Chapter 2941 - 173: Want You Dead
content:
Chapter 2941: Chapter 173: Want You Dead

Why, suddenly I can’t perceive causality...

The Pavilion Elder’s aged fingers couldn’t help but pinch together, then slowly release, then pinch together again, forcing himself to let go.

He really wanted to calculate.

But now he is "retired" and doesn’t want to get involved in the murky waters of the Great Wilderness, which exude black aura.

Once he takes action to calculate, it would be equivalent to reaching into the murky water to fish out causality for a look.

It’s easy to dirty one’s hands and also easily noticed by others.

But if he doesn’t calculate, it’s also impossible.

Deep in the Pavilion Elder’s heart, he felt a vague chill, not knowing what happened.

It was also like a thousand ants crawling, unbearably itchy, wanting to know what exactly occurred.

"This Formation is a Yin Yang Ancient Formation, and because of its immense cause, we had to make some minor adjustments to obscure the causality. Giving it to him, was for him to learn and comprehend..."

"What exactly did this kid use it for..."

"In the end, what can a mere Foundation Establishment Realm kid do with such a Formation? Surely he..."

The Pavilion Elder suddenly shivered.

What can a Foundation Establishment use this Formation for?!

What is it that only the Foundation Establishment Realm can do?!

The Pavilion Elder, who was long unperturbed like an ancient well, suddenly had the feeling again as if his heart would leap out of his throat.

"He... can’t be... shouldn’t be..."

The Pavilion Elder finally couldn’t contain himself.

Regardless of dirtying his hands, he pinched his three fingertips together. With just a pinch, the Heavenly secret mental method operated, and causality turned in his mind.

The Pavilion Elder’s heart utterly died.

The Ancient Formation, which he had manipulated, was actually refined into a Lifebound Formation?!

How was this accomplished?

The Pavilion Elder’s expression was heavy, and his brow gradually furrowed.

The cultivation world is vast, with countless geniuses. Magic Treasures of the Lifebound Formation type have indeed been cultivated by some, and many legacies passed down.

But refining a Formation into a Magical Treasure of one’s own is not something that can be easily talked about.

It requires an understanding of the essence of Formations, proficiency in the application of Formations, a deep analysis of the human body’s structure, and extensive experience in "transforming" the human body.

Many spell points are involved, with complex methods.

The Five Elements, Eight Trigrams, and under other categories like Three Talents, Four Symbols, Six Yao, Seven Stars, each specific Formation, if one were to refine it into a Life Formation, would require different legacy and methods.

The complexity of Five Elements and Eight Trigrams type "Life Formation" alone is significant.

For a while, the Pavilion Elder couldn’t imagine what kind of Tao cultivation and fortune would be necessary to refine a "Yin Yang" type Ancient Formation into a Life Formation.

This Yin Yang Rebirth Formation is something sealed by the Heaven Shu Pavilion, ancient and profound to the extreme, even he, as a Pavilion Elder, did not understand it thoroughly.

No matter how extraordinarily talented this child is, or how high his comprehension might be, he is ultimately just at the Foundation Establishment Realm, with limited vision and experience. At most, he can gain some insight; it is absolutely impossible for him to "master" such a Yin Yang Ancient Formation.

"Could it be that this kid... is of another species?"

"Is he actually not ’human’?"

"But even if he is a deity born of the Dao, it shouldn’t be so outrageous..."

Moreover...

The Pavilion Elder soon realized a problem.

This probably isn’t just as simple as refining a "Yin Yang Life Formation."

Judging from Mo Hua’s style of action within the Qian Learning State Boundary, and from the previous brief meeting where he gauged Mo Hua’s temperament.

This is a child with a straightforward temperament but does not adhere to "rules."

A child who appears reckless but is actually meticulous.

Often acting with great boldness, bold enough to make one’s skin crawl.

Yet, despite his boldness, anything he does is actually done with "deep thought," involving profound considerations and extremely meticulous planning.

His attitude towards other things is like this, let alone towards his own "Lifebound Formation."

The Pavilion Elder can almost assert that Mo Hua, this child, now cannot possibly know the true mystery of the Wood Revitalization Formation.

Because, within it, are means laid by him personally.

At most, he might have some suspicion—as this is the Sword Discussion Conference’s reward, it cannot truly be ordinary.

If he usually uses this Formation to save people, engaging in "saving the dying and the injured," he should be able to grasp some insights from the operation of the Formation, then think through its inherent Law step by step.

This would greatly benefit his future cultivation.

As for the extent of his understanding, it depends on Mo Hua’s own fortune.

This is also the Pavilion Elder’s judgment of the progress of Mo Hua’s comprehension after obtaining the Formation.

In the short term, Mo Hua can’t really "see through" this Formation, let alone comprehend it.

Something "unperceivable," with Mo Hua’s "cautious" character, is suitable for research.

But if he indeed took it for Life and Spirit Cultivation as a "Lifebound Formation," that is absolutely impossible.

This implies that the "Lifebound Formation" Mo Hua set for himself actually includes something else.

This Yin Yang Ancient Formation is very likely something Mo Hua added in for some unknown consideration, "incidentally."

It’s "incidentally"!

He incidentally integrated this earth-shattering and ghost-wailing Yin Yang Rebirth Ancient Formation into his Lifebound Formation...

The Pavilion Elder’s feelings were indescribably complex.

At the same time, he felt even more incredulous.

This child’s mind, how is it even formed?

What kind of legacy, motive, thought process, and spell points were involved in refining his Lifebound Formation?

And what exactly... did he create?

Within the Pavilion Elder’s heart now, it’s as if a hundred thousand ants were crawling.

He really wants, using the "Wood Revitalization Formation" he provided as a "Cause and Effect Line," to follow the vine to find the melon, unveiling the entire inside story of Mo Hua’s Lifebound Formation, and all the underlying Laws that compose it, so he can clearly understand it.
